claims.reason: Distinct Hylsa gas batch production at Monterrey, not global first; Tenova HYL News 2015 opening editorial gives December 1957 and iron for EAF, EPA Direct Reduction 1980 HyL process and Table 6 independently corroborates the 1957 plant and batch scheme. No matched industrial gas direct-reduction record found.

Hylsa Quintero 2001, pp.607–613 describes self-reforming scheme and industrial 4M output from April 1998; 2003 HYL High Carbide Iron pp.4–5 independently accessible original developer paper confirms same month and scheme, and BlueScope/U Wollongong Port Kembla 2022 p.136 corroborates process generation and 1998 commercial start. Builds_on edge is process-level lineage, not direct machinery transfer, with intervening generation; BlueScope independently describes HYL I–II–III–ZR progression.

SSAB 21 June 2021 lead confirms approximately 100 tonnes by announcement and 31 August 2020 pilot startup; EC JRC INCITE direct-reduction bullets independently describes initial natural-gas reference and 2021 hydrogen runs; HYBRIT 2024 pilot trials section records cumulative >5,000 tonnes, not annual production. Tenova 12 February 2024 para 2 and BlueScope p.135 table independently name ENERGIRON/HYL-ZR at pilot; directed adapts link refers to method generation and no physical 4M transfer.

SSAB 18 August 2021 paras 1–2, HYBRIT paragraph supports July Oxelösund rolling and trial shipment; identifies pilot iron, explicitly attributed. Volvo 13 October 2021 p.1 supports load carrier made using SSAB steel, not exact shipment. Luleå-to-Oxelösund lot provenance remains candidate because JRC attests separate Swerim trials and lacks independent exact lot confirmation.

Inventory: 2021 HYBRIT trial demonstrated and 2024 cumulative campaign output, not continuous commercial deployment; Nucor 2026 Q3 10-Q Note 14 and Overview identifies Nu-Iron as producing for steel mills, with site-level volume and daily status qualified; Midrex 2017 history states 1998 Convent startup, physical 2004–06 relocation and 30 Dec 2006 Trinidad production. Gällivare: June 2026 court permit, LKAB Q2/Q3 2026 reports appeals and next instance, Q1 p.20 grant withdrawal without disbursement; proposed not completed. Alternatives: Midrex 2019 history identifies 1967 Toledo pilot and 1969 Portland commercial prototype; Circored manufacturer brochure p.3 and Cleveland-Cliffs 10 December 2001 8-K confirm hydrogen route and 2001 output/idling. Alternatives do not establish an unqualified Portland-to-Trinidad transfer.
